storyTagline: A fourth straight title in Atlanta, a first MVP for Orlando Larienne and a new career tackle leader in San Francisco.

stories.headline: Five Straight for Skura, and a Fourth in a Row for Atlanta
stories.dek: The Falcons went 13-4, beat the Bears, Eagles and Rams, then routed the Texans 48-13 in Super Bowl CXLV.

stories.headline: Larienne Throws for 50 and Takes the MVP
stories.dek: Orlando Larienne threw 50 touchdown passes in 19 games and won the league's top individual award in his third season in Atlanta.

stories.headline: Maxwell Adds a Sixth Ring and a Second Super Bowl MVP
stories.dek: Ryland Maxwell ran for 2,150 yards and 35 touchdowns, then closed the season as the Most Valuable Player of Super Bowl CXLV.

stories.headline: No Second-Year Slide: Adam Is Offensive Player of the Year
stories.dek: Apollo Adam caught 114 passes for 2,200 yards and 22 touchdowns and played all 21 of Atlanta's games.

stories.headline: Record Watch: Settle Takes the Career Tackle Lead
stories.dek: K'Lavon Settle made 212 tackles in 17 games and passed both Mose Junior and Jayon Queen. The mark is his at 2,965.

stories.headline: Suh Crosses the Bar as the Jets' Core Keeps Producing
stories.dek: Kalif Suh's Career Legacy reached 7,503, making him the Y86 Hall of Fame class, and Jimmy Tillery threw 31 touchdown passes without an interception.

stories.headline: Atlanta Reloads: Saine and Clapp Arrive, Woodrum Adds a Seventh
stories.dek: Two first-year Falcons won rings, Simeon Otton collected his fourth and Calais Ham kept the line in order.

stories.headline: Houston Gets Its Second Look at Skura, and the Same Ending
stories.dek: The Texans lost Super Bowl CXLV 48-13. Their only other final against Dorren Skura, in Y38, ended the same way.

vault.text: He changed his name to God. Then he earned it. Career Legacy 12,005, inaugural class.

vault.title: Hall of Fame · Rondale Ikarras
vault.text: Flashy, loud, unstoppable, and he knew it. He was that guy. Career Legacy 11,949, inaugural class.

vault.title: Hall of Fame · Ian Finney
vault.text: The first superstar. The Infinity Man. Career Legacy 10,852, inaugural class.

vault.title: Hall of Fame · Levante Hopkins
vault.text: The quiet one who did the dirty work. Career Legacy 10,834, inaugural class.

vault.text: Some players chase records. Cairo Asanjh chased Ian Finney. Career Legacy 9,873, inaugural class.

vault.title: Hall of Fame · Jackson Wardell Kline
vault.text: Tyrion Kline's son did not live in anyone's shadow. He built his own. Career Legacy 9,635, inaugural class.

vault.title: Hall of Fame · Charlie John
vault.text: Seven straight Super Bowls. Charlie John was there for every one of them. Career Legacy 9,532, inaugural class.

vault.text: Some defensive linemen are measured in sacks. Zander Kolar was measured in tackles. Career Legacy 8,893, inaugural class.

vault.title: Hall of Fame · Lukas Russell

vault.title: Hall of Fame · Jayon Queen
vault.text: Two Defensive Player of the Year awards. Only one other player in this league has ever matched that. Career Legacy 8,767, inaugural class.

vault.title: Hall of Fame · Nick Bolton
vault.text: One of the originals, and he never stopped tackling. Career Legacy 8,712, inaugural class.

vault.title: Hall of Fame · Ray Waller
vault.text: Never count out a man whose nickname is a promise. Career Legacy 8,500, inaugural class.

vault.title: Hall of Fame · Bilal Tolbert
vault.text: No individual trophies. Four rings. And a sack record nobody has caught. Career Legacy 8,440, inaugural class.

vault.title: Hall of Fame · Tyrone Baugh
vault.text: Seven seasons, seven championships, and Tyrone Baugh has a ring for every one of them. Career Legacy 8,420, inaugural class.

vault.title: Hall of Fame · Lloyd Queen

vault.title: Hall of Fame · Amani Bryant
vault.text: The best quarterback never to win a ring. Career Legacy 7,822, inaugural class.

vault.title: Hall of Fame · Mose Junior

vault.title: Hall of Fame · Lamar Jackson
vault.text: The league never had to explain who he was. He was just Him. Career Legacy 7,715, inaugural class.

vault.title: Hall of Fame · Tyler Pacheco

vault.title: Hall of Fame · Akiem Bouye

vault.title: Hall of Fame · Michael Wilson

vault.title: Hall of Fame · Jakeem Friend
vault.text: Linemen do not win trophies. Jakeem Friend won seven rings instead. Career Legacy 11,481, Y80 class.

vault.title: Hall of Fame · Jason Macleone
vault.text: One look at Scary Jerry and you understood the name. Career Legacy 7,596, Y80 class.

vault.title: Hall of Fame · Pharoah Hunter
vault.text: The other receiver in the Vikings dynasty was never anybody's second option. Career Legacy 7,585, Y80 class.

vault.title: Hall of Fame · Abraham Ward Jr
vault.text: Eleven tackles a game, every game, for 236 games. Career Legacy 7,547, Y82 class.

vault.title: Hall of Fame · Malakai Sawyer
vault.text: Some backs have a great season. Malakai Sawyer keeps having them. Career Legacy 7,720, Y84 class.

vault.title: Hall of Fame · Von Horsted
vault.text: Fifteen seasons, one team, and a tackle on almost every series. Career Legacy 7,350, Y84 class.

vault.title: Hall of Fame · Juwann Gilman
vault.text: Thirteen seasons in Arizona, and almost twelve tackles every time he takes the field. Career Legacy 7,540, Y85 class.

vault.title: Hall of Fame · Kalif Suh
vault.text: A Jets linebacker since Y76, and the middle of that defense has rarely moved without him. Career Legacy 7,503, Y86 class.
